tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments, Docker and Kubernetes, production troubleshooting, Git, code reviews and agile teams. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

cover_en.subject: Application: Bhargavi Mocharla
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in joining your team. With over 5 years of professional backend experience specializing in SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in Java, Spring, and enterprise e-commerce platforms.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Cloud & Java
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring for Rockwell Automation.

bullets.label: OCC REST APIs
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and custom Interceptors, Populators, and Converters for seamless data flows.

bullets.label: Integrations & Data Pipelines
bullets.text: Built and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders, and DataHub to synchronize global product catalogs.

bullets.label: Platform Operations & CI/CD
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) and managed core Hybris modules including the Promotions Engine and OMS at Shell.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit, requiring no sponsorship. I am currently serving my notice period with my last working day on 15.12.2026, and I am available to start from 16.12.2026. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my background aligns with your needs.

tailoring.why_company: I am eager to contribute my 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud and Java backend expertise to your dynamic projects. Having built and scaled enterprise e-commerce platforms for global clients like Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am excited about the opportunity to bring my technical skills in OCC REST APIs, integrations, and platform optimization to your team.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud and Java backend expertise from enterprise roles at Rockwell Automation and Shell to support your technical goals.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello, I am an SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with 5+ years of enterprise experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I have strong skills in Java, Spring, OCC REST APIs, and e-commerce platforms. Based in Germany with a valid work permit, I am available from 16.12.2026.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Bhargavi Mocharla - SAP Commerce Cloud Developer
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my application documents for the role. With over 5 years of backend and e-commerce experience building and supporting large-scale platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring strong expertise in Java, Spring, OCC REST APIs, and data integrations.

I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit. My last working day is 15.12.2026, and I can start on 16.12.2026.

I look forward to discussing my profile with you.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
